notes.title: Speedruns and other things!
notes.content:
Hey gang! We are thrilled to see so many of you enjoying the new Drawn Below DLC! We set out to make a challenging and unique Stickman adventure, and the feedback we've received thus far has been great.

One thing we've noticed is the focus on completing the "Speed Runner" achievement! While developing the game, our team members had a lot of fun competing with each other on who could get the fastest time. For those of you who think you've got what it takes, see if you can beat our times!

[b][h1]"Speed Runner" Times[/h1]
Any% Completion
[olist]
[*]Chad - 23:49
[*]Clint - 24:08
[*]Matt - 29:46
[*]Jordan - 41:09    [i]<-- that's me =([/i]
[/olist]
100% Completion
[olist]
[*]Clint - 32:19
[*]Jordan - 1:06:53     [i]<-- me again =([/i]
[/olist][/b]
Okay, so I'm not the fastest. If you're speedier than any of us, post a screenshot and let us know in the comments below! (Looking at you, Siha... [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=724473515]you're getting close![/url])


Another very quick announcement: we are aiming to submit an update next week to squash a couple tiny bugs. If you see any oddities while you're playing, let us know!

Thanks!

notes.title: Drawn Below is here!
notes.content: Drawn Below DLC is now officially available for purchase!  To celebrate the release, the DLC is available for a short time at 40% off!  Sharpen your pencils and get your sketchbook ready.  You've got an inkvil dungeon to explore.

notes.title: Epic 2 DLC Bubbles Up From Below on 7/11/2016
notes.content: Something dark lurks beneath the world of Epic 2. Seemingly vanquished at the end of our most recent adventure, it now appears as if the evil ink isn’t quite finished. Explore the ruins of the Inkvil Fortress with your Stickman and discover the secrets it holds. Metroidvania gameplay pairs with familiar abilities and tools to make a brand new experience. Slay new enemies, solve new puzzles and find your way to the source of the ink to seal it away forever. Get the [b]Drawn Below DLC[/b], available on 7/11/2016!

notes.title: Community Update!
notes.content:
Draw a Stickman: Epic 2 has just been updated with new features to allow Steam users to share drawings to and use drawings from the [url=http://gallery.drawastickman.com/]Epic 2 Art Gallery[/url]. Display your stickmen, their friends, your swords, and more on our community gallery, and select drawings from other players across all platforms to use in your adventure!

In addition to this major feature, we've also fixed a number of bugs with the Sketchbook UI and collision in various chapters as well as a major bug that could cause users to become stuck at the end of Chapter 7.
